title: 95 Cloud Tokens, Three Files Patched
caption:
Google ran an agent that patched three files and spent 95 cloud tokens.

The split is the whole trick — Gemini 3.8 Flash only ever saw filenames and task descriptions, while a local Gemma 4 did the audit, the patch, the critique and the regression tests. 3,322 of 3,417 tokens never left the machine.

I'm not running this tomorrow. It wants more than 24GB of VRAM and my laptop doesn't have it. But the architecture is the part I'm stealing: let the cheap cloud model plan, let the local one grind.

How much VRAM you got?

slides.headline:
95 Cloud Tokens.
3 Files Patched.
slides.sub: Google's Antigravity SDK added local models on Sept 23. Its demo audited and patched auth.py, billing.py and database.py.

slides.title: Cloud Plans, Local Builds
slides.sub: The planner saw filenames and task descriptions. Local Gemma 4 26B reproduced the bugs, wrote patches, critiqued them, ran tests.

slides.headline:
97.2% Stayed
On Your GPU
slides.sub: 3,322 of 3,417 tokens ran on-device. No API cost, no rate limits, and no source code leaving the machine.

slides.headline:
It Wants 24GB+
Of VRAM
slides.sub: Google recommends more than 24GB of VRAM or unified memory for Gemma 4 26B. One recorded demo, not a guarantee.
